subject: Renewal: hosted API commit step-up + rateband adjustments
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@marketly.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning + request to increase hosted commit

Hi Mina,

Quick note from our side as we approach renewal: usage has climbed faster than expected. We currently run on the 10M token/month hosted commit plan but our forecast for Q3/Q4 suggests ~22-28M tokens/month steady-state with occasional spikes during campaigns.

Could you share options for:
- Increasing monthly committed tokens (25M target)
- Adjusting tiered unit pricing for a higher commit
- Increasing per-second rate limits (we'd like to support higher concurrency for peak windows)
- Burst/backstop (short bursts of ~8-10M) and how that impacts billing

I've attached a short usage runbook and a month-by-month projection for the last 6 months. We want to lock a 12-month renewal by July 10 if possible.

Thanks — can we set a 30-minute call tomorrow morning?

Olivia
Head of Product, Marketly

Attachments: Marketly-usage-runbook.pdf (PDF), traffic-projection.csv (CSV)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning + request to increase hosted commit

Hi Olivia — thanks for the context and the runbook, this is helpful.

We're available tomorrow 9:30–10:00am PT. I can loop in Marissa (AE) and Karthik (pricing/ops) so we can put a concrete proposal on the table during the call.

High-level thoughts before we chat:
- We can map Marketly to our 25M commit band with a staged onboarding (week 1: prefix caching + KV tuning, week 2: rate limits bumped and canary routing).
- Typical approach: 12-month commitment at an uplifted tier with a small commit discount (we'll model a blended unit price).
- We normally include a burst cushion (we can offer a monthly burst pocket of 10M tokens that draws from a separate allowance at a locked rate for the contract term).

I'll put together a short mutual action plan and an initial numbers sheet to review on the call. See HubSpot deal for notes: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567/DEAL-98765

Best,
Mina
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: Renewal planning + request to increase hosted commit — pricing + ops ask

Folks — forwarding Marketly's ask from Olivia (below). They want to move from 10M to ~25M tokens/month and need higher concurrency and a burst cushion. Call scheduled tomorrow 9:30 PT.

Quick proposed approach before the call:
- Commit band: 25M tokens/month, 12-month term.
- Pricing: propose $0.0009/token blended (current unit at 10M band is $0.0011) — margin still healthy and gives them an incentive to commit.
- Burst pocket: 10M tokens/month included, consumed after the committed pool is exhausted and billed at the same blended rate for simplicity.
- Rate limits: increase sustained per-customer RPS to 60 r/s from current 30 r/s during peak windows; include canary for first 48 hours after cutover.
- Ops: prefix caching -> increase hit-rate targets, tune KV cache, and enable temporary autoscale burst nodes for first 14 days. Post-cutover runbook to be delivered by Ops.

Open questions for pricing/legal:
- Do we want to gate the 10% list discount or roll it into a term-based credit?
- Do we need SLA amendment for higher RPS (they've asked for predictability during campaign peaks)?

I've attached the proposal workbook — fill the tab labeled "Model A: 25M" with alternate pricing if you have suggestions.

-- Mina

Subject: RE: Renewal planning + request to increase hosted commit — proposal

Hi Olivia / Marketly team — great conversation today. Per the call, here's a concise proposal and next steps so we can hit your July 10 target.

Proposal (summary):
- Term: 12 months starting Aug 1, 2026
- Committed tokens: 25,000,000 tokens / month
- Unit price: $0.0009 / token (blended), invoiced monthly based on committed consumption; overages billed monthly at the same unit price (we will not auto-bill per-token beyond committed + burst pocket without prior notice)
- Burst pocket: 10,000,000 tokens / month (monthly allowance) at the same blended rate; bursts draw from the pocket first then the overage ladder
- Rate limits: sustained per-customer rate to 60 requests/second during configured peak windows; we will perform a 48-hour canary after cutover with rollback hooks
- Onboarding/ops: 2-week staged cutover (prefix caching and KV tuning, autoscale burst nodes enabled for initial 14 days), runbook and playbook deliverable by our Ops team within 48 hours of signature
- SLA ask: we can extend a narrow latency SLO for peak windows for an addendum; legal to confirm wording.

Commercials and next steps:
1) We will issue a redlined MSA addendum and the 12-month SOW for signature.
2) Proposed commercial: 12 monthly invoices of $22,500 (represents 25M * 0.0009 = $22,500) — we can adjust to quarterly billing if preferred.
3) If Marketly can sign by July 10, we can guarantee the lock-in pricing and include the 10M burst pocket for the first 3 months at no extra fee.

Attachments: Marketly-commit-proposal-v1.xlsx (contains model A/B/C). DocuSign link will follow once legal agrees on minor SLA wording.

Please confirm: 1) acceptance of the numbers above, and 2) billing cadence preference (monthly vs quarterly), and we will route to Legal/Finance.

Thanks — excited to keep Marketly running smoothly through the campaign season.

Best,
Mina Haddad
